meta.source: Linux 程序设计上机实验 —— 动态库创建与调用 / make 工程化构建
meta.note: 本文件中的 output 均为 CentOS 7 客户机上的真实终端输出，账户 wht

steps.title: 创建实验目录
steps.command: sudo mkdir -p /root/wht+OtherHeadFiles /root/wht+OtherLibs && sudo chown -R wht:wht /root/wht+OtherHeadFiles /root/wht+OtherLibs && ls -ld /root/wht+OtherHeadFiles /root/wht+OtherLibs
steps.output:
drwxr-xr-x. 2 wht wht 21 Oct 24 02:01 /root/wht+OtherHeadFiles
drwxr-xr-x. 2 wht wht 23 Oct 24 02:06 /root/wht+OtherLibs

steps.title: 编译生成动态库 libadd.so
steps.command: cd /root/wht && gcc -fPIC -shared -I../wht+OtherHeadFiles/ -o libadd.so add.c && ls -l libadd.so && file libadd.so
steps.output:
-rwxr-xr-x. 1 wht wht 7880 Oct 24 02:11 libadd.so
libadd.so: ELF 64-bit LSB shared object, x86-64, version 1 (SYSV), dynamically linked, not stripped

steps.title: 链接生成可执行程序 Compute
steps.command: cd /root/wht && gcc Compute.c -o Compute -I../wht+OtherHeadFiles/ -L../wht+OtherLibs/ -ladd && ls -l Compute && file Compute
steps.output:
-rwxr-xr-x. 1 wht wht 8400 Oct 24 02:14 Compute
Compute: ELF 64-bit LSB pie executable, x86-64, version 1 (SYSV), dynamically linked, interpreter /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2, not stripped

steps.title: make 一键构建
steps.output:
gcc -c -o del_str.o del_str.c
gcc -c -o print_str.o print_str.c
gcc -c -o mystr.o mystr.c
gcc -o Str del_str.o print_str.o mystr.o

steps.title: 运行 make 产物
steps.output: Hllo Linux, wlcom to C Programming!

steps.title: make clean 清理中间产物
